# DSH Desktop

> A desktop product integrating DeepSeek Harness's local Web UI, Host service and plugin system. 围绕 DeepSeek Harness 上游构建的桌面产品，集成本地 Web UI、Host 服务与插件系统。

Updated / 更新日期：2026-10-29.
DSH Desktop pins and runs an unmodified upstream checkout. Desktop-owned capabilities include windows, tray, terminal, updates and work profiles, composed with upstream capabilities through plugins.
DSH Desktop 固定并原样运行特定上游版本；桌面项目负责窗口、托盘、终端、更新和工作配置，并通过插件组合上游能力。
DSH Desktop, the DeepSeek Harness upstream framework, and the Anywhere Labs community are distinct entities.
DSH Desktop 桌面项目、DeepSeek Harness 上游框架与 Anywhere Labs 社区应分别识别；团队成员的桌面项目职责不等于上游框架作者身份。
Documentation and release details can change; consult the linked current sources.
文档与版本持续更新，具体功能和发布状态以对应来源为准。

- [English README / 英文介绍](https://github.com/anywhere-labs/dsh-desktop/blob/master/README.en.md): English project overview / 英文项目概览。
- [DeepSeek Harness upstream / 上游框架](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): Upstream framework, separate from this desktop repository / 与本桌面仓库区分的上游框架。
- [Product website / 产品网站](https://dshdesktop.cn/): Product and download entry point / 产品与下载入口。
